name: claude-toolkit
description: BeSpunky's Claude Code skills, subagents and commands. Develop once here; install and continuously upgrade across all projects.

plugins.name: bespunky
plugins.description: The BeSpunky toolkit front door. /bespunky:index is a self-maintaining catalog of every installed toolkit skill, grouped by plugin with its invocation and a one-line 'use when', read from the live skill set so it never goes stale. Typing /bespunky in the slash menu filters to the whole toolkit. Also rotates a few tips for installed toolkit plugins into Claude Code's working spinner; turn them off, on or list them with /bespunky:tips.

plugins.name: bespunky-house
plugins.description: The BeSpunky house standard for any repo, as a stack of detected layers on an Nx floor: the agent DX (composed devcontainer, Claude settings, window identity, HOUSE docs) by default; Node, JS libraries, the stack-free web dev loop, Angular, a design system, navigation or Firebase only when worn. /bespunky-house:new creates a project, /bespunky-house:upgrade migrates one to the current standard, /bespunky-house:add-layer adds a layer. Generator-first; consented, never automatic.

plugins.name: bespunky-workflow
plugins.description: How work moves from idea to production, whatever is being built. branch-and-release: a declared branch model (trunk to gitflow), per-feature worktrees, human-gated moves. local-server-isolation: test servers on random free ports. feature-package: one effort, one slug, one folder of durable docs. session-handoff: relay one live effort into a fresh session. project-standing: orient in a project after a gap. delegate-and-parallelize: orchestrate budgeted subagents.

plugins.name: bespunky-engineering
plugins.description: BeSpunky engineering skills, stack-agnostic. Foundation: architect-mentality (the mindset) and architecture-first (solve through design, not patches; fix the root cause). Technique routers: software-design, advanced-typescript, nx-monorepo-and-dx. Plus resumable-state (a deliberate home for view and working state) and typed-reactive-navigation (typed per-domain navigation, never a raw router call), each with an Angular adapter. Angular-only skills live in bespunky-angular.

plugins.name: bespunky-angular
plugins.description: BeSpunky's Angular adapter skills, for projects that wear Angular. angular-architecture: modern-Angular technique clusters (standalone, signals, inject()) - DI and providers, lifecycle and reactivity, SSR and change detection, extensibility, content projection, component APIs. angular-native-wrappers: wrap an imperative or third-party JS API (maps, editors, charts, players) in idiomatic, type-safe Angular. The stack-agnostic mindset they realize lives in bespunky-engineering.

plugins.name: bespunky-design-system
plugins.description: BeSpunky design-system skills - styling as a SYSTEM on any stack (Angular is one adapter). design-system-first: the discipline - every visual value is a token from the design system, no raw hex, magic px or style reach-ins, and a pattern's second occurrence is promoted into the DS. design-tokens-and-theming: the techniques - token tiers, CSS custom properties as the runtime layer, a zero-output SASS API, light/dark/brand modes, encapsulation, and the DS library's entry points.

plugins.name: bespunky-browser-automation
plugins.description: BeSpunky browser automation. `playwright` — drive a real browser headless (load, click, type, screenshot, scrape) for solo verification, bug repro, or repeatable scripts. `shared-browser` — one in-container Chromium the human watches and clicks over noVNC while Claude drives it over loopback CDP: co-debugging, live CSS/DOM verification with measured proof, pairing on a flow. Pre-installed and enabled in BeSpunky devcontainers.

plugins.name: bespunky-product-ux
plugins.description: BeSpunky product & UX design — a pipeline from messy request to built UI: distill-the-brief (the real problem), envision-the-experience (the felt world), stage-the-vision (bold web-native art), mock-to-choose (concepts judged by eye), realize-the-vision (the researched build). Beside it: astonishing-to-use (the co-equal UX force), redesign-means-rethink (redesign from a blank canvas), keep-users-oriented (waits and steps), model-intent-not-data (intent in, decisions out).

plugins.name: bespunky-voice
plugins.description: Hear Claude's questions and answer by voice, away from the screen. Questions are asked the way a person asks them (`/speak say`, or automatically with `/speak auto on`). A band above the prompt shows what's said and heard, live, with Replay and Stop. The `voice-conversation` skill + `ask_by_voice` MCP tool run a hands-free back-and-forth. Swappable TTS (espeak-ng / say, upgradable to local Piper), local whisper.cpp STT; audio bridged by the BeSpunky devcontainer.

plugins.name: bespunky-vscode-identity
plugins.description: Make every project's VSCode window recognizable at a glance, without Peacock's whole-window glow. `window-identity` picks a project-fitting emoji for the window title and a quiet bar colour derived from the design-system primary (else a stable name hash), written by the @bespunky/nx-tools:window-identity generator with a no-clobber ratchet. A SessionStart hook offers the upgrade to the brand colour once a design system appears.

plugins.name: bespunky-communication
plugins.description: How Claude speaks: ships the 'Pitch to the listener' output style, every answer pitched to the person reading it. Brief by default, for a reader who stepped out; full depth the moment they engage. One question per message, placed last; short reports of finished work that never drop a caveat; structure only where it earns its place; no unexplained jargon or bare verdicts. Presentation only. Default in BeSpunky projects; elsewhere pick it with /output-style.
